title: China reportedly recruited executive to spy on Nvidia CEO
excerpt: China's intelligence agency allegedly recruited a Megaspeed executive to gather information on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and American AI chips.
body_html:
China's intelligence agency reportedly recruited a Megaspeed executive named Alice Huang to gather information on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, according to a report by The New York Times. The Ministry of State Security enlisted her to learn more about American artificial intelligence chips.

Additionally, the intelligence agency aimed to potentially influence Nvidia to push for its most advanced chips to be made available to China.
